blurb: Guests board the William D. Evans, a three-story Mississippi-style sternwheeler, for themed cruises on Mission Bay. Cruises include live DJs, games, snacks, and cash bars. Special event cruises include Sunday Fun & Games, Halloween Party, and Oktoberfest Party.
extraNote: No refunds, cancellations, rebooking or retroactive discounts on Sunday Fun & Games Cruise · Cruises subject to inclement weather and capacity limitations · If cancelled due to weather, may reschedule Sunday Fun & Games Cruise · Outside food or beverage not permitted on all cruises · Hotel reserves right to refuse service based on applicable laws · Parking at Bahia Resort Hotel limited to hotel guests; complimentary parking at Ventura Cove for Sunday Cruise · Bahia Resort Hotel and Catamaran Resort Hotel and Spa docks on Mission Bay · June through September for Sunday cruises; specific dates for special events
